invariants.rationale: Method returns the result of execute(), which should provide HoodieRestoreMetadata.
restoreInstantTimestamp is required for restore and is passed directly to the action executor.
savepointToRestoreTimestamp is required for restore and is passed directly to the action executor.
context is an engine context required for distributed operations and is passed to the executor.
The return type of the method is HoodieRestoreMetadata, so result must be an instance of it.
